questions.question: Which description fits the **MeasureReport** resource?
options: This resource contains the results of the calculation of a measure; and optionally a reference to the resources involved in that calculation.
A structured set of tests against a FHIR server or client implementation to determine compliance against the FHIR specification.
This resource provides the definition of a quality measure.
A summary of information based on the results of executing a TestScript.
questions.explanation: **MeasureReport**: The MeasureReport resource contains the results of the calculation of a measure; and optionally a reference to the resources involved in that calculation. The other descriptions belong to **TestScript**, **Measure**, **TestReport**.

questions.question: Which resource matches this definition from the specification? “This resource contains the results of the calculation of a measure; and optionally a reference to the resources involved in that calculation.”
questions.explanation: This is the definition of **MeasureReport** (Specialized › Quality Reporting & Testing).

questions.question: Where does **MeasureReport** sit in the FHIR R4 resource list?
questions.explanation: **MeasureReport** is in **Specialized › Quality Reporting & Testing**: Quality measures and their results (Measure, MeasureReport), and scripts and reports for testing FHIR systems (TestScript, TestReport).

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **MeasureReport** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of MeasureReport are `status` (1..1), `type` (1..1), `measure` (1..1), `period` (1..1). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.

questions.question: Which element of **MeasureReport** is a **modifier** (?!), so receiving systems must not ignore it?
questions.explanation: Modifier elements of MeasureReport: `status`, `improvementNotation`. `improvementNotation`: increase | decrease. A modifier can change the meaning of the whole resource, so systems must understand it before using the data.
